changelog: Security release — please update. Fixes several access-control issues found in a security review (advisory GHSA-hmxr-c2q9-q929).
Folder downloads no longer follow links that point outside the endpoint's own backups.
The forced password change at first sign-in is now enforced by the server, not just the login page.
Updates are now cryptographically signed, and St0r refuses to install an update whose signature doesn't check out (from the next update onward).
Downloads and restores are now recorded in the log with who did them.
The session cookie is marked Secure automatically when St0r is served over HTTPS.
